_comment: A stand-in for the feedback context endpoint serving F3, for looking at Build B without n8n. Point VITE_FEEDBACK_CONTEXT_URL at /feedback-context-manager-review.sample.json and any token-shaped ?t= on /feedback/manager-recruitment-review opens it, because a static file cannot verify a signature — so this belongs on a local or preview build only. Everything here is invented: there is no manager called Peter Njoroge and no such requisition.
_alreadySubmitted: Set this to true to see the already-answered screen instead of the form.
_prefill: fullName is the MANAGER, not a candidate — the rule on every instrument is that it names whoever is filling the form in. hiresMade is how many people were hired against this requisition; it is what makes 'quality of candidate pool' answerable. subjectName, payroll and reviewPoint belong to other instruments and are null here.
